payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into how Counterfactual Data Augmentation (CDA) affects gender bias in predictions and performance, indicating that it can mitigate contextual biases and improve model performance.

claims.text: Counterfactual Data Augmentation (CDA) mitigates contextual biases by equalizing the contexts for masculine and feminine words in training data.
CDA, combined with other debiasing methods, significantly increases model performance and reduces gender bias in predictions.
The use of CDA leads to more balanced predictions across genders, reducing discrepancies in model performance.
